top_signals.title: Hong Kong Leans Into Yuan Bond Boom as Debt Hub Rivalry Builds
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong, Asia’s leading hub for bond underwriting for more than a decade, is making the most of a record flurry of offshore yuan debt issuance as competition for fixed-income business across financial centers intensifies.

top_signals.title: Berkshire may boost Japan trading house holdings, Itochu says
top_signals.summary: The U.S. investment firm owns stakes of more than 10% in Mitsubishi, Sumitomo, Mitsui, Marubeni and Itochu.
